title: Strengthen the allocated-revision contract for failed narrow observation persistence
outcome: The allocated commit revision remains explicit or mechanically checked on both success and persistence error, so a future pre-allocation failure cannot silently publish a duplicate TestRunChanged revision.
acceptance: The persistence helper/caller boundary encodes or asserts whether a revision was allocated on every error path without changing current persistence and failure publication semantics.
A regression retains factual Failed publication at exactly one newly allocated revision for actual synchronous persistence failure and preserves contiguous observation revisions.
The focused observation/publication and persistence tests pass on the final input.
